name: EzAiRapVideo
tagline: Turn your photos into an AI rap music video
description: EzAiRapVideo is an AI rap video generator that turns one or two photos into a short rap performance, right in your browser with no app to install. Upload a portrait, or two portraits to perform as a duo, pick a stage such as Orange Studio, Street Cypher, Neon Rap MV, Funny Rap, or a custom stage, then write lyrics or let the AI write them from an occasion like a birthday or anniversary. Videos come in HD with no watermark and can be downloaded and shared anywhere.
